subject: Customer technical walkthrough + SE rehearsal / availability check
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Donna Lewis <donna.lewis@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: Customer technical walkthrough + SE rehearsal / availability check

Hi team,

FintechCo (Sam/Donna) would like a deep technical walkthrough next week focused on inference latency, network egress controls, and key management options. They indicated security and procurement will attend – looks like a 75–90 minute session.

Proposed windows (all times UTC):
- Tue 2027-04-13: 15:00–16:30
- Wed 2027-04-14: 10:00–11:30 or 17:00–18:30
- Tue 2027-04-20: 15:00–16:30

Priyom / Ava — can you confirm SE availability for these windows? I also want to schedule a quick 45-minute SE rehearsal the day before to run the demo scripts and handoffs.

Attached: FintechCo_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf (high-level agenda & participants).

Next steps: once we lock a slot I will send a calendar invite and the pre-read (architecture diagram + sample prompts).

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: FintechCo_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Donna Lewis <donna.lewis@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Customer technical walkthrough + SE rehearsal / availability check

Thanks Marissa — Priyom here. Available windows look good from my side except I have a standing on-call on Wed mornings until 11:00 UTC.

My suggested plan:
- Book Tue 2027-04-20 15:00–16:30 UTC for the customer walkthrough (90 min capacity to accommodate security/procurement asks).
- Schedule a SE-only rehearsal Mon 2027-04-19 14:00–14:45 UTC to validate slides, test access to FintechCo samples, and coordinate who will cover keys/egress discussion.

Ava — can you make the rehearsal on Apr 19 at 14:00 UTC? I can own the live demo sequence and the k-v cache walkthrough; please take the architecture/networking notes.

I will need the following before rehearsal:
- Sample prompts and expected token lengths (so I can run a small perf pass)
- Any firewall/VPN requirements from FintechCo for connection test

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fintechco.com>

Cc: Donna Lewis <donna.lewis@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: 2027-04-11T14:55:00Z
Subject: Re: Customer technical walkthrough + SE rehearsal / availability check

Thanks — the proposed windows look reasonable. A couple of constraints from our side:

1) Security wants a full 90-minute slot (they rarely leave early). Prefer Tue or Wed afternoon.
2) Procurement needs a short pricing/term readout at the end of the session (15 minutes) — Donna is on this thread.
3) Can you share SOC2 summary and a short pricing sheet before the session so procurement/security can triage?

We can confirm Tue 2027-04-20 15:00–16:30 UTC. Apr 19 at 14:00 UTC for rehearsal also works for our engineers to join a 20-minute checkpoint if needed (they have limited calendar availability).

Sam
Sam Patel | Platform Eng Manager, FintechCo
sam.patel@fintechco.com

Date: 2027-04-12T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Customer technical walkthrough + SE rehearsal / availability check

Looping in a short security checklist — happy to join the session. For planning, please provide before the walkthrough:
- SOC2 summary (PDF) — executive summary + controls in-scope
- Network architecture diagram showing traffic egress points and any proxy/VPN endpoints
- KMS integration options (we support KMS/HSM patterns; if customer uses managed KMS please include IDP details)
- Any PII/data retention expectations for the demo data set

We'll review the SOC2 summary and let procurement know if we need extra time. If possible, send these artifacts 72 hours in advance.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2_summary_fintechco_request.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

- Customer technical walkthrough: Tue 2027-04-20, 15:00–16:30 UTC (90 minutes)
- SE rehearsal: Mon 2027-04-19, 14:00–14:45 UTC (SEs only, 45 minutes)
- Rehearsal checkpoint for FintechCo engineers: Mon 2027-04-19, 14:30–14:50 UTC (20-minute overlap)

Marissa will send the calendar invites (link below) and I have attached the pricing summary we discussed. Neha — SOC2 summary attached as requested.

Pre-reads (attached + links):

- SOC2_summary_fintechco_request.pdf

- Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-fintechco-technical-walkthrough

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Best,
